# Paths copied from an upstream SuiteSparse:GraphBLAS tag into vendor/GraphBLAS/.
# Consumed by refresh-graphblas.sh: one path per line, relative to the upstream
# repo root. Directories are copied recursively.
#
# This is an allowlist on purpose: if a future upstream version needs a
# directory that is not listed here, the verify build at the end of
# refresh-graphblas.sh fails during the upgrade. Add the path and re-run.

# Build system. build.rs parses cmake_modules/GraphBLAS_version.cmake.
CMakeLists.txt
cmake_modules

# Apache-2.0 requires shipping the licence.
LICENSE

# Regenerated by cmake from Config/README.md.in into the source tree. Shipped
# so the build does not leave an untracked file behind.
README.md

# Compiled sources: Config/*.c, Source/*/*.c, PreJIT/*.c, FactoryKernels/*.c.
# Config also holds every *.in template (GraphBLAS.h.in, GraphBLAS.pc.in,
# GB_config.h.in). Include holds GraphBLAS.h, which the regen-bindings feature
# reads. JITpackage receives a generated empty GB_JITpackage.c when the JIT is
# off, and is on the include path.
Config
Include
Source
PreJIT
FactoryKernels
JITpackage

# Bundled third-party code compiled into the library.
lz4
xxHash
zstd
cpu_features

# On the include path unconditionally (CMakeLists.txt include_directories).
rmm_wrap
Demo/Include

# Not built today (upstream forces GRAPHBLAS_USE_CUDA OFF); kept so a future
# GPU build configuration does not need a re-vendor.
CUDA
